patterns.key_values: squarified treemap / mosaic data-viz: ~2px near-black gaps, ~6-8px tile radius, 0px inset full-bleed, area encodes bytes, dominant tile ~40% area = pre-attentive focal point; unlabeled tiles in the static view

signature_moves: Name-as-interface: 'DriveMosaic' literalized as a gap-separated jewel-tile mosaic; icon repeats the exact treemap motif in a squircle - total icon+UI+name identity coherence
Size-as-hierarchy: no color de-emphasis by design (correct for a treemap) - largest tile is both the visual peak and the actionable insight (biggest space hog)
defects: Contrast Dilution - window title #3D3D44 on #0B0B10 near-black ~1.8:1
Non-Apple palette (tell) - treemap is Tailwind-500, not the 12-hue system palette; excluded from macOS canon

Icon-vs-cover palette contradiction - the app icon renders the treemap in a muted, bevelled, hand-tuned palette (dusty mauve/sage/olive/terracotta/tan, soft top highlights) while the cover uses flat max-saturation Tailwind; the two artifacts disagree on the real look
Information-scent gap (UX, static) - tiles have color but no labels/sizes/legend; cannot identify the big block without interaction (out of static scope)

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark) - the Linear/Vercel dark-hero reflex the aesthetic-direction map flags as the current default-model look: Tailwind-500 palette on near-black with an indigo gradient accent word

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect (Kurosu & Kashimura) - the saturated mosaic + dark hero are engineered for the ~50ms first-impression appeal; buys forgiveness on first contact
Von Restorff / signal-detection - size makes ONE tile dominant (indigo ~40%), correctly directing attention to the biggest space hog; the app's job resolved pre-attentively

Information scent (Pirolli & Card) - VIOLATED in the still: colored but unlabeled tiles give no scent for WHICH folder is the hog; a disk analyzer depends on quick what-is-this reads (likely resolved by hover, out of static scope)
Jakob's Law - mac users predict a real titlebar; the recreation mostly honors it but dimmed traffic-light hexes subtly break the prediction
notes: cover.png is a 1200x630 web OG composite, NOT a screenshot: brand hero (left) + a DRAWN macOS-window depiction (right). Two proofs the window is rendered not captured: dimmed non-Apple traffic-light hexes, and pixel-exact Tailwind-500 tiles. So window tokens describe the depiction, not confirmed shipping UI. Lineage is genuinely unclear: circumstantial evidence (real macOS squircle icon, single-platform 'macOS 14+', $4.99 one-time, disk-analyzer genre) leans native-indie, but the sole UI artifact reveals no AppKit tells and uses a web palette - hence lineage=unknown/low, nothing feeds macOS canon. KEY CONTRADICTION for synthesis: the app ICON uses a muted, tasteful, bevelled treemap palette while the COVER uses flat Tailwind saturation - the real app look is unresolved; a genuine screenshot would settle it (and would also let lineage/era/density be classified properly). No sidebar, toolbar, settings, forms, empty-state, or light-mode evidence yet. Icon.png was viewed for brand context only - NOT digested (Workflow A only; no icons/ file written).
